2. This petition has been filed by the petitioners under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for unfreezing of the six bank accounts as mentioned in para 5 of the petition on the ground that the criminal case registered against the petitioner at Crime No.162/2022 under Sections 420, 409 and 120-B of the IPC has already been closed as all the accused persons have already been discharged by the Trial Court vide order dated 05.10.2023.

sentences.text: 3. The grievance of the petitioner is that despite the order of discharge, their bank accounts have not been unfreezed by the Bank of Baroda, Kotak Mahindra Bank, ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank and Bank of India, which accounts were freezed soon after the FIR was lodged on 04.04.2022.
Thus, the petitioners' grievance is that despite their discharge, the Police has not intimated to the Bank to unfreeze the accounts of the petitioners.

4. This Court on the last date of hearing i.e. on 13.04.2024 has directed the S.H.O. of the concerned Police Station to mark his appearance before this Court, considering the seriousness of the offence,
as it appears that the petitioners are being unnecessarily harassed and pursuant thereto, Shri Manish Mishra, S.H.O. Police Station Palasia is present in person and he has submitted that he has joined recently.
However, he has not denied that the petitioners have already been discharged and the bank accounts have still not been unfreezed.
It is submitted that since the Court has not passed the order for unfreezing the bank accounts, hence, the Police has not proceeded to request the Banks to unfreeze the accounts of the petitioners.
5. Counsel for the respondent/State has submitted that appropriate order may be passed.

6. On due consideration, this Court is inclined to dispose of this petition with a direction to the respondent to immediately apprise the aforesaid Banks to unfreeze the petitioners' accounts with immediate effect, so that the petitioner can operate the same.

Let this exercise be done positively,
within further three days' time.
7. With the aforesaid, the petition stands disposed of.

(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE Bahar Suhanika Chaure vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27567803/
